audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Parallel Convergence 'stuns anyone who lingers inside it' in early, spikes[0], whys[0] and wants.you[0]. That is not what the ability does.
audit.why: Riot's text: the anomaly slows enemies caught inside, and Ekko stuns only if EKKO enters it — 'If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.' So the tell is his movement, not the circle. It also means Emperor's Divide's knockback is a real answer: he cannot enter what he has just been thrown away from. Phase Dive is also an auto-attack reset from 325 range, so the wind-up is the cue, and Timewinder damages on the return as well as the throw.
audit.corrected: Stun condition corrected everywhere it appeared; Timewinder's return hit, Phase Dive's reset and the Divide knockback written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit and dosFull[2].d gave no number for the window a spent Chronobreak opens.
audit.why: Chronobreak 110/80/50, Timewinder 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14, Phase Dive 9 down to 7 — every one of them is a schedulable window and none were on the page.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and the do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, despite Chronobreak healing off the damage you deal.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags this matchup needs-antiheal; without Grievous Wounds your kill becomes his full reset.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds tied to the first-item row and to playing from behind.

edits.before: Ekko's Parallel Convergence zone stuns anyone who lingers inside it, and Timewinder's slow lets him set that trap up even through your soldier poke — because Chronobreak makes his all-ins reversible, he can afford to take risks in lane that you can't.
edits.after: Parallel Convergence only stuns when EKKO steps into the anomaly — until he does, it is a slow. Watch his feet, not the circle. Timewinder hits going out and again on the rewind, so a dodged throw is only half a dodge, and his Q is back in 9 seconds.

edits.before: He remains ahead through level 6 since Chronobreak-backed dives are low-risk and his roams punish your lack of early map presence, though there are windows where his cooldowns are down and trades are closer to even; only once you hit Emperor's Divide can you reliably interrupt his zone setup and turn a fight back in your favor.
edits.after: Chronobreak is 110 seconds at rank 1 and heals him off the damage you just dealt, so an all-in you win on damage can still end with him alive. Emperor's Divide is the counter: knock him back and he cannot walk into his own anomaly, which is the only way that field ever stuns you. Spend R on his commit, not on the wave.

edits.before: With Divide online you can finally knock him out of a completed Convergence field before the stun lands, and full soldier scaling plus item power lets you out-damage him in extended fights — a scaled Azir has more sustained pressure than an assassin whose combo you can now disrupt.
edits.after: Divide throws him back off the anomaly he needs to enter, which removes the stun and the shield in one cast. Full soldiers out-range a 325 Phase Dive by a mile, and with Grievous Wounds bought his rewind heals for a fraction — a scaled Azir kills him and keeps him dead.

notes: The biggest correction here is mechanical, not cosmetic: four fields said Parallel Convergence stuns anyone standing in it. Riot's text says the anomaly slows, and the stun happens only when EKKO enters it. That changes the advice from 'do not stand in the circle' to 'watch his feet', and it is what makes Emperor's Divide's knockback a real counter — he cannot enter a field he has just been thrown away from. Also added: Timewinder damages on the return trip, Phase Dive is an auto-attack reset from 325 range (the wind-up is the tell), and Chronobreak's heal makes Grievous Wounds a build item in this matchup rather than an afterthought. The packet's two suspectNames are false positives — Chronobreak and Parallel Convergence are the real names. Chart: full disagreed with content and the packet on rows 3-6; aligned to Ekko / Azir / Ekko / Azir with every why rewritten in the same proposal. phases[N].rating left untouched — see questions. Not asserted: whether Phase Dive's teleport crosses Emperor's Divide terrain, and whether the knockback can displace him during the Chronobreak untargetable window. Neither is in Riot's text.
